minor.issue: Model class doesn't define uptime_kuma_url field; it's stored/retrieved via direct MongoDB dict operations in setup.py routes. Works correctly at runtime but violates model-driven design. Not breaking but worth adding the field to ServiceConfig model for consistency.

integration_issues.flow: Settings tab - Clear Uptime Kuma URL
integration_issues.issue: SettingsTab.jsx line 65 uses `serviceConfig.uptime_kuma_url || undefined` - when user clears the URL field and saves, empty string is falsy so `undefined` is sent to axios which omits the param, meaning the backend won't clear the stored URL. Can set the URL but cannot clear it from the Settings tab.

Uptime Kuma URL Cannot Be Cleared.root_cause: SettingsTab.jsx handleSaveServiceConfig() at line 65: `uptime_kuma_url: serviceConfig.uptime_kuma_url || undefined`. When user clears the input to empty string, `'' || undefined` evaluates to `undefined`. Axios omits undefined params from the request. Backend receives no uptime_kuma_url param and skips the update (if uptime_kuma_url is not None: ...).
Uptime Kuma URL Cannot Be Cleared.reproduction: 1. Set uptime_kuma_url in Settings to any value. 2. Clear the input field. 3. Click Save Configuration. 4. Check /portal/status - it still shows the old URL.
Uptime Kuma URL Cannot Be Cleared.mitigation: Change line 65 to: `uptime_kuma_url: serviceConfig.uptime_kuma_url !== '' ? serviceConfig.uptime_kuma_url : ''` or simply always send the value: `uptime_kuma_url: serviceConfig.uptime_kuma_url`
